title: Aurora Solar Trust Center Profile: SOC 2 and Subprocessors
markdown:
Residential solar design and sales solutions that are accurate at every stage, from design to signed permit, with physics-based accuracy.

Summary from the company’s website.

## Publicly advertised compliance posture

As observed on November 3, 2026 on the organization’s public trust
center.

- SOC 2

Independent CPA audit of controls for security, availability, and confidentiality.

- PCI DSS

Payment card industry standard for handling cardholder data securely.

- GDPR

Public claim of alignment with the EU General Data Protection Regulation.

- EU-US DPF

Publicly advertised on the organization’s trust center.


## Public security hygiene

Four public signals on aurorasolar.com, one point each, checked at the November 3, 2026 refresh.

2/4
ahead of 26% of the Trust Center Directory.

- ✗**security.txt**: a contact file at /.well-known/security.txt
- ✓**SPF**: an SPF record on the domain
- ✓**DMARC enforced**: policy p=quarantine
- ✗**DNSSEC**: signed zone

Hygiene is measured on the company domain, independent of any compliance claim. Check your own with the
[scorecard](https://synergetic.solutions/resources/trust-center-directory/scorecard/).

## Published controls

Controls Aurora Solar chose to publish on its trust center
, last updated November 3, 2026.
A published list is the organization's own selection, showing passing controls only; it is not a statement of coverage.

17

Controls published

17

Marked passing by the platform

- Infrastructure security
- Organizational security
- Product security
- Internal security procedures

## Compliance timeline

1. July 2024

Trust center first observed in public web archives

2. November 3, 2026

Posture last observed by Trust Center Directory


## Subprocessors

Aurora Solar discloses 30 third-party subprocessors on its trust center, including 2 AI / LLM providers.

60%

chain trust: 18 of 30 disclosed
subprocessors are themselves in the Trust Center Directory.

The full subprocessor list, with purpose, location and AI-provider flags, and the dependency graph across the index are part of the directory's enriched dataset. [Contact us](https://synergetic.solutions/resources/trust-center-directory/aurorasolar/#contact) for access.

## About this data

The Trust Center Directory reports only what organizations publicly advertise. A missing
framework here means no public claim was observed as of November 3, 2026;
it never means an organization is non-compliant. [Request a correction](https://github.com/synergetic-solutions/trust-index-data/issues/new/choose);
corrections are verified against public evidence. Read the full
[methodology](https://synergetic.solutions/resources/trust-center-directory/methodology/).
